notes: SIGHTS: iron sights are see-through; red dots and holos sit just above the front post on every gun; the holo is smaller and cleaner, with a big clear window and a smaller reticle ring
STATS: separate ONLINE and OFFLINE career pages; online kills, deaths and rounds now count properly
PRIVATE MATCHES: a lobby before the match - the host picks mode, map, number of bots, time limit and kill limit, friends join by code or on your Wi-Fi, host presses START
END OF MATCH: full scoreboard after every game, then the next match starts by itself (45 s offline, 40 s online) with a full reset
ONLINE: pausing no longer freezes the match for anyone, and a minimised host keeps the game running
KEYBINDS: new Settings tab to rebind every key; new MELEE key (V by default)
GUN GAME: bots play gun game too, and there is a short delay before you can fire each new gun
SPAWNS: many more spawn points on every floor, randomised and spread out so bots no longer spawn clumped
WINDOWS: glass you can see through but not shoot through
Grenades throw much farther; soldiers hold their rifles properly in their hands
ATTACHMENTS: pros and cons are stronger and actually change how the gun handles
